title: Object resolution analogue with unknown class
purpose: Target object-resolution behavior more directly than discovery-only seeds by sending a valid explicit request to a likely unsupported class path.
expected_behavior: A compliant implementation should parse the explicit request and likely return an object/path-level error such as Object Does Not Exist or Path Destination Unknown, without framing failure.
constraints_preserved: Outer framing is complete and little-endian.
Session handle is nonzero due to prior RegisterSession.
CPF item count and item lengths are exact.
CIP request path size is 2 words with exactly four EPATH bytes.
Only documented CIP service code 0x01 is used.
issue_safety_notes: This is a safe structural analogue for object-resolution behavior and does not use malformed discovery payloads or any stack-overflow reproduction.
